newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Gulf rigs down one at 167 in the week.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Gulf rigs down one at 167 in the week.

text.p: There were 167 rigs under contract in the U.S. Gulf as of June 27, down one from the period ending June 20, Offshore Data Services said Friday.
The utilization rate for rigs working in the Gulf, based on a total fleet of 176, was 94.9 percent.
The number of working rigs in the European/Mediterranean area was unchanged at 110 rigs under contract out of a total fleet of 113, a utilization rate unchanged at 97.3 pct.
The worldwide rig count was also unchanged at 576 out of a total fleet of 604, with an unchanged utilization rate of 95.4 percent.
